Delhi luxury tour – 2 days

New Delhi · Old Delhi · 2 days

2 days New Delhi tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

Delhi at its most comfortable — a premium chauffeured car, a night in a luxury hotel, fine dining, and both halves of the city at an easy pace.

At a glance

Duration
2 days, 1 night
Destinations
New Delhi · Old Delhi
Transport
Premium chauffeur-driven car
Accommodation
1 night in a luxury hotel
Tour type
Private
Pickup
Hotel, airport or railway station

What makes this one worth it

  • A premium car and professional chauffeur for both days
  • Qutub Minar and Humayun's Tomb with a licensed guide
  • Lunch and dinner at premium restaurants
  • India Gate, Rashtrapati Bhavan and a walk in Lodhi Garden
  • Jama Masjid, Chandni Chowk, the Lotus Temple and Akshardham
  • An evening of shopping for crafts, textiles and jewellery

Your day by day

  1. Day 1 · 9:00 AM

    Pickup in a premium car

    Your chauffeur meets you at your hotel, the airport or the station.

  2. Day 1 · 9:30 AM

    Qutub Minar

    An hour and a half at the UNESCO-listed tower and its carved courtyards.

  3. Day 1 · 11:30 AM

    Humayun's Tomb

    The Mughal garden tomb that shaped the Taj Mahal, and its quiet lawns.

  4. Day 1 · 1:15 PM

    Lunch

    Lunch at a premium restaurant, Indian or international.

  5. Day 1 · 2:45 PM

    India Gate and Lutyens' Delhi

    A photo stop at India Gate and a drive past Rashtrapati Bhavan and Parliament House.

  6. Day 1 · 4:30 PM

    Lodhi Garden

    An unhurried walk among the 15th-century tombs and gardens.

  7. Day 1 · Evening

    Hotel and dinner

    Check in to your luxury hotel, then dinner at a premium restaurant.

  8. Day 2 · 9:00 AM

    Jama Masjid and Old Delhi

    After breakfast, the great mosque of Shah Jahan and the lanes around it.

  9. Day 2 · 10:30 AM

    Chandni Chowk

    The old bazaars for textiles, spices, jewellery and street food, with a rickshaw ride if you want one.

  10. Day 2 · 12:30 PM

    Lunch

    Lunch at a restaurant known for classic North Indian cooking.

  11. Day 2 · 2:00 PM

    Lotus Temple and Akshardham

    The Lotus Temple and its gardens, then Akshardham's carved stone halls.

  12. Day 2 · 5:30 PM

    Shopping, then drop-off

    Time for crafts, textiles, jewellery and designer stores, then drop-off at your hotel, the airport or the station around 7 pm.

What the price covers

  • Premium chauffeur-driven car for both days
  • 1 night in a luxury hotel with breakfast
  • Licensed English-speaking guide
  • Airport or station pickup and drop
  • Fuel, tolls, parking and driver allowance

What it does not cover

  • Monument entry tickets
  • Lunches and dinner
  • Shopping and personal expenses
  • Tips

Questions people ask

Which hotel do we stay in?
A five-star or luxury heritage hotel of your choice — we send two or three options with the quotation.
Is Akshardham open every day?
It is closed on Mondays. On a Monday we move it to day one or swap in another site.
Can it start from the airport?
Yes. Day one can begin straight off your flight.
